# GetCreditWorth
> Find the best audiobooks to spend your Audible credits on — data-driven Value Score rankings, credit calculator, and curated recommendations.

## Core Pages
- [Home - Top Audiobooks Ranked](https://getcreditworth.com/): 7,550 audiobooks ranked by Value Score formula: (Duration × Rating) / Price
- [Credit Calculator](https://getcreditworth.com/calculator): Calculate how much your Audible credits are worth and get personalized recommendations
- [All Books](https://getcreditworth.com/books): Browse all 7,550 scored audiobooks with filters (duration, rating, category)
- [Compare](https://getcreditworth.com/compare): Compare up to 4 audiobooks side by side on 9 dimensions
- [Dataset](https://getcreditworth.com/dataset): Free open dataset of 7,550 Audible audiobooks, CSV, MIT licensed
- [About](https://getcreditworth.com/about): About GetCreditWorth, Value Score methodology, and affiliate disclosure
- [Blog](https://getcreditworth.com/blog): 139 guides on Audible credit strategy
